'''Relacite''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], and a member of the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] family. For millennia, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] used Adegan crystals, including relacite, as the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] in their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TotJC" /> 

Relacite was a relatively common variant of Adegan crystal.<ref name="TotJC" /> However, crystals from outside the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]] have also been identified as relacite, such as those found in the towering spires of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Relacite crystal mines|mines]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
